const ACCEPTANCE_ERROR_CODES
const ADMISSION_GUARANTEES
enum AcceptanceOutcome
  ACCEPTED = 'accepted'
  DEFINITELY_NOT_ACCEPTED = 'definitely_not_accepted'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  KEY_CONFLICT = 'key_conflict'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
dataclass AcceptanceResult
  outcome: AcceptanceOutcome | None
  receipt: Receipt | None
  reason: str
enum CancellationOutcome
  REQUESTED = 'requested'
  ALREADY_TERMINAL = 'already_terminal'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  UNSUPPORTED = 'unsupported'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
dataclass CancellationResult
  outcome: CancellationOutcome | None
class DispatchError(ValueError)
  __init__(code)
enum FailureCause
  OTHER = 'other'
  DIGEST_MISMATCH = 'digest_mismatch'
  OVERSIZE = 'oversize'
  SHORT_TRANSFER = 'short_transfer'
  UNAUTHORIZED = 'unauthorized'
  NOT_FOUND = 'not_found'
  REFUSED = 'refused'
  SERVER_ERROR = 'server_error'
  TRANSPORT = 'transport'
  RESULT_LOST = 'result_lost'
  CREDENTIAL = 'credential'
enum FailureClass
  RETRYABLE = 'retryable'
  PERMANENT = 'permanent'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
dataclass HistoryWindow
  logical_owner: str
  history_epoch: str
  minimum_retention_ms: int
  result_retention_ms: int
enum InventoryOutcome
  PAGE = 'page'
  GAP = 'gap'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
dataclass InventoryPage
  outcome: InventoryOutcome | None
  snapshots: list[OperationSnapshot]
  next: str
  complete: bool
class JobInventory
  list_work(cursor: str, limit: int) -> InventoryPage
class JobInventoryClient(JobInventory)
  __init__(transport)
  list_work(cursor: str, limit: int) -> InventoryPage
class JobOperator
  list_account_work(cursor: str, limit: int) -> InventoryPage
  cancel_operation(operation_id: str) -> OperatorCancellation
class JobOperatorClient(JobOperator)
  __init__(transport)
  list_account_work(cursor: str, limit: int) -> InventoryPage
  cancel_operation(operation_id: str) -> OperatorCancellation
enum ObservationOutcome
  OBSERVED = 'observed'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  DEFINITELY_NOT_ACCEPTED = 'definitely_not_accepted'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
dataclass ObservationResult
  outcome: ObservationOutcome | None
  snapshot: OperationSnapshot | None
class OperationControl
  observe_work(identity: RequestIdentity) -> ObservationResult
  read_result(identity: RequestIdentity, offset: int, max_bytes: int) -> ResultRead
class OperationControlClient(OperationControl)
  __init__(transport)
  observe_work(identity: RequestIdentity) -> ObservationResult
  read_result(identity: RequestIdentity, offset: int, max_bytes: int) -> ResultRead
dataclass OperationSnapshot
  receipt: Receipt
  state: WorkState | None
  progress: WorkProgress
  cancellation_requested: bool
  failure: WorkFailure | None
  label: str
  label_derived: bool
  waiting: str
dataclass OperatorCancellation
  outcome: OperatorCancellationOutcome | None
enum OperatorCancellationOutcome
  REQUESTED = 'requested'
  ALREADY_TERMINAL = 'already_terminal'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
const RESOURCE_ACTIONS
dataclass Receipt
  identity: RequestIdentity
  logical_owner: str
  operation_id: str
  accepted_guarantees: list[str]
  history_retention_ms: int
class RecoverableAcceptance
  get_history_window() -> HistoryWindow
  submit(submission: Submission) -> AcceptanceResult
  reconcile(identity: RequestIdentity) -> AcceptanceResult
  cancel_work(identity: RequestIdentity) -> CancellationResult
class RecoverableAcceptanceClient(RecoverableAcceptance)
  __init__(transport)
  get_history_window() -> HistoryWindow
  submit(submission: Submission) -> AcceptanceResult
  reconcile(identity: RequestIdentity) -> AcceptanceResult
  cancel_work(identity: RequestIdentity) -> CancellationResult
class Refusal(ValueError)
  __init__(word, offset)
dataclass RequestIdentity
  key: str
  history_epoch: str
  attempt: int
dataclass ResultChunk
  receipt: Receipt
  offset: int
  total: int
  data: bytes
  eof: bool
enum ResultOutcome
  DATA = 'data'
  NOT_READY = 'not_ready'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
  UNSUPPORTED = 'unsupported'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
dataclass ResultRead
  outcome: ResultOutcome | None
  chunk: ResultChunk | None
class ServiceError(Exception)
  __init__(code, message)
enum ServiceErrorCode
  HANDLER_ERROR = 'handler_error'
  INVALID_RESULT = 'invalid_result'
  UNKNOWN_VERSION = 'unknown_version'
  UNKNOWN_SERVICE = 'unknown_service'
  UNKNOWN_METHOD = 'unknown_method'
  WRONG_MODE = 'wrong_mode'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
dataclass Submission
  identity: RequestIdentity
  kind: str
  spec: bytes
  required_guarantees: list[str]
  label: str
dataclass WorkFailure
  classification: FailureClass | None
  message: str
  cause: FailureCause | str
dataclass WorkProgress
  done: int
  total: int
enum WorkState
  PENDING = 'pending'
  RUNNING = 'running'
  TRANSFERRED = 'transferred'
  COMPLETE = 'complete'
  FAILED = 'failed'
  CANCELLED = 'cancelled'
def decode(data)
def encode(v)
def service_name(frame)
